Check Gorilla data for common problems

Source: R/checks.R
gorilla_checks.Rd

Lists participants and tasks that may need a closer look before the analysis. Each row describes one finding. The function removes nothing, so you decide what to exclude.

Usage

gorilla_checks(
  x,
  fast = 200,
  max_fast = 0.1,
  max_same = 0.9,
  min_responses = 10,
  balance = 1.5
)

Arguments

x

A gorilla_data object from read_gorilla().

fast

Reaction time in milliseconds below which a response counts as fast.

max_fast

Largest acceptable proportion of fast responses.

max_same

Largest acceptable proportion of identical responses.

min_responses

Fewest responses in a task for the same_response check to apply.

balance

Largest acceptable ratio between the largest and the smallest group of a randomiser node.

Value

A tibble with columns check, participant_private_id, task_name and detail, with no rows if nothing was found.

Details

The checks are

status

Participants whose status is not complete, such as live or rejected participants included by hand.

versions

Data from more than one version of the experiment.

duplicate

The same public ID under several private IDs, which usually means that someone took part more than once.

missing_task

Participants who did not do a task that most participants with the same randomiser and branch outcomes did.

unbalanced

Randomiser nodes whose groups differ in size by more than the ratio balance.

device

Participants who used a different type of device from most participants.

fast

Participants with more than the proportion max_fast of responses in a task faster than fast milliseconds.

same_response

Participants who gave the same response in more than the proportion max_same of at least min_responses responses in a task where other responses were possible.

See also

summary.gorilla_data() for an overview of each task.

Examples

g <- read_gorilla(gorilla_example(), quiet = TRUE)
gorilla_checks(g)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 4
#>   check        participant_private_id task_name       detail                    
#>   <chr>        <chr>                  <chr>           <chr>                     
#> 1 status       9100222                NA              status is live            
#> 2 missing_task 9100222                Rhyme judgement not done, although 2 of 3…
